decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southeastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted (including basement) shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 26 Prebend Gardens, Chiswick, W4.
Condition : 7 - The basement shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as 26 Prebend Gardens, Chiswick, W4 1TW.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 2pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Refurbishment of 26 Prebend Gardens and erection of single storey side and rear extension and basement to be used as single family dwelling house.
